decision: Mirror real files instead of symlinking into the store
why: Agent Read, Write and Bash were all denied through a symlink that leaves the working directory
evidence: two claude -p runs on scratch linktest

decision: Name a project by owner-repo from origin
why: Stable across clones and worktrees, readable when browsing the store
result: Falls back to the folder name without a remote

decision: Remove locally what the store deleted since the last sync
why: A file deleted in one checkout came back from the other
result: Deletes and moves now carry over

decision: checkpoint: script cases and one agent session
why: Goal names save, restore and prompt-free writes
